name: Tanihara Mizuki
source:
She is a single mother, 28 years old, who gave birth at a young age.

She has a cheerful and outgoing personality, and is optimistic with a friendly and open attitude toward everyone. 

She speaks her mind clearly, but sometimes she says things too bluntly and later regrets it.

She is a single mother with only one child, but the relationship between parent and child is good.

Currently, she has her hands full with taking care of her son, and she has put her own needs on the back burner.
